column3: NASB follows the critical text (“God's fellow worker”) without the Textus Receptus “minister and,” and renders “concerning” as “as to.”
NASB follows the critical text; “be moved” is rendered “be disturbed.”
NASB renders “we were telling beforehand” as “we kept telling you in advance.”
NASB renders “lest perhaps” as “for fear that” and “the one tempting” as “the tempter.”
NASB renders “having evangelized us” as “has brought us good news” and “you have a good remembrance of us” as “you always think kindly of us,” and adds “long to see.”
NASB renders “we were encouraged” as “we were comforted.”
NASB follows the critical text (“stand firm”); it adds “really.”
NASB renders “are we able to give” as “can we render.”
NASB renders “super overexcessively imploring” as “keep praying most earnestly” and “supply” as “complete.”
NASB follows the critical text without “Christ”; “would direct” is rendered “may … direct.”
NASB follows the critical text without “Christ” and has no “Amen”; “strengthen” is rendered “establish,” and “blameless” is “unblamable.”
